note: Starfire skin palettes. Ramps are dark → light, matched to the source ramps by luminance order (tools/starfire/build_skins.py). Skin tones and outlines are never recoloured; eye geometry is fixed (only the three eye tones change). Ids are sf_* and never end in 'AlienX' or contain 'cyborg'.

skins.name: Blackfire-Inspired — Dark Sister
skins.inspiration: Komand'r / Blackfire, Starfire's older sister (Teen Titans 2003 'Sisters'; DC Comics)
skins.research: Blackfire is drawn with long black hair, violet eyes and a dark purple / black outfit with silver trim; her starbolts are purple.
skins.notes: Hair blue-black, eyes violet, costume black-violet, boots black, metal silver, hand energy / starbolts / explosion / laser violet.

skins.name: Alien X — Celestial Princess
skins.inspiration: Alien X's starfield-black body, white horns and green eyes (Ben 10: Alien Force)
skins.research: Alien X is a void-black humanoid whose body shows a moving starfield, with white horn plates and bright green eyes.
skins.notes: Costume and boots void black with a precomputed starfield; hair white-silver; metal white; eyes kept vivid green; energy white-green.

skins.name: Chromastone — Prism Heart
skins.inspiration: Chromastone's violet-magenta crystal body that absorbs and refracts energy (Ben 10: Alien Force)
skins.research: Chromastone is a crystalline Crystalsapien in magenta / violet with black stripes; its blasts are rainbow-tinged light.
skins.notes: Costume magenta crystal with an iridescent prism layer, hair deep rose, metal pale crystal, eyes white-pink, energy magenta.

skins.name: Upgrade — Living Circuit
skins.inspiration: Upgrade's black liquid-metal body with glowing green circuit lines and a single green eye (Ben 10)
skins.research: Upgrade is a Galvanic Mechamorph: glossy black with bright green circuitry; its techno-energy is green.
skins.notes: Costume and boots gloss black with sparse green circuit glints; hair charcoal with green tips; metal green circuitry; eyes and energy neon green.

skins.name: Ghostfreak — Spectral Star
skins.inspiration: Ghostfreak's pale grey-white body, black chest bands and violet eye (Ben 10)
skins.research: Ghostfreak is an Ectonurite: ghost-white skin with black stripes, a single purple eye and violet ghostly energy.
skins.notes: Costume ghost-grey, boots black, hair smoke-grey, metal black band, eyes violet; energy pale violet. Her skin tones are unchanged (never recoloured).

skins.name: Pink Nova
skins.inspiration: Original design: a hot-pink nova colourway
skins.notes: Costume hot pink, boots deep magenta, hair rose-magenta, metal rose gold, eyes pink-white; energy / starbolts / laser pink.

skins.name: Infinity Sky
skins.inspiration: Gojo's white hair, unblindfolded Six Eyes sky-blue irises and Limitless blue / red / purple (JJK)
skins.research: Gojo wears a dark navy uniform; with the blindfold off his Six Eyes are a vivid sky blue. No blindfold is drawn here — eye geometry is unchanged.
skins.notes: Hair snow white, eyes sky blue (no blindfold), costume midnight navy, boots black, metal pale ice; energy / laser Limitless blue.

skins.name: Solar Empress
skins.inspiration: Original design: a royal Tamaranean sun-gold colourway (Tamaran's sun-fed power)
skins.research: Original cosmetic palette. Tamaraneans draw power from solar energy (DC canon), which this palette celebrates.
skins.notes: Costume regal gold, boots bronze, hair flame orange-gold, metal bright gold, eyes amber; energy / explosion solar gold.

skins.name: Aurora Glitter
skins.inspiration: Original design: northern-lights teal and violet with glitter
skins.notes: Costume aurora teal with precomputed glitter, boots deep violet, hair teal-violet, metal silver-teal, eyes mint; energy teal.

skins.name: Opal Supernova
skins.inspiration: Original design: pearl-white opal with a shifting iridescent sheen
skins.notes: Costume pearl-white with an iridescent opal layer, boots pearl grey, hair rose-pearl, metal pearl, eyes opal blue-green; energy white-rainbow.
